intro: Lelanai is a night elf mount handler residing in the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus. She provides the fierce saber mounts of the night elves to worthy riders, offering both standard nightsabers and swift war beasts to her kin and trusted allies of Darnassus.

p: Stationed beside riding instructor Jartsam among the towering trees of the Cenarion Enclave, Lelanai attends to some of the finest big cats bred in Kalimdor. Night elves have long formed profound bonds with the fierce predators of northern forests, training nightsabers and frostsabers to carry sentinels and scouts across rugged terrain with predator grace. Lelanai serves as the primary provider of these revered mounts in the capital.

While saber mounts are freely offered to any night elf of appropriate skill, outsiders face a much stricter threshold. Given the sacred nature of the cats and the natural aloofness of the kaldorei, Lelanai will not entrust a beast to non-night elf adventurers unless they have earned the highest degree of respect and renown with the city of Darnassus.
